_comment: Which JIZURA sources are bundled. Edit this, then re-run tools/build_bundle.py. The original JIZURA checkout is never modified.

core_excluded.02_fonts.js: replaced by src/runtime/30_fonts.js - the browser font loader uses async/await, which the Qt QML JS engine cannot parse
core_excluded.10_audio.js: browser AudioContext decode + IndexedDB; the plugin gets beats from the host instead
